alignment: Order-free, per-code occurrence pairing (k-th occurrence of a code in kjv-osis pairs with the k-th in oshb). Matched pairs assert 'same lexeme attested in this verse', not word-order correspondence. Surplus occurrences become omissions/additions; the omissions themselves are exact. Excluded from alignment on both sides: tokens with no Strong's number (23 OSHB prefix-only words in Genesis 31) — counts and omissions cover coded tokens only. Quirk: scrollmapper sometimes merges the object marker H853 into a verb span (e.g. 'created' carries H853+H1254), so matched H853 pairs show the verb's English span against the standalone Hebrew word et.

sources.kjv-osis: scrollmapper tagged KJV (English spans; some lemmas merged)
sources.oshb: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (Hebrew words; complete tagging)

kjv-osis.span_text: And it came to pass at the time
with all that he had; and he rose up
from me; and didst not tell
me, that I might have sent thee away
that thou hast so hotly pursued
not unto thee; I bare the loss
had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away
mine: and what can I do
I and thou; and let it be for a witness
between me and thee this day
between me and thee, when we are absent
that I will not pass over
to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over
